title: On Astonishing everybody in the room
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：astonish　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 astonish 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the fisherman ① astonished everybody in the room without complaint, and every boatman in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the fisherman ② astonishes everybody in the room with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ astonish everybody in the room at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ astonished everybody in the room before — a line in the logbook for July 1961 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Astonishing everybody in the room without complaint, the fisherman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ astonish even the oldest hands with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Astonish even the oldest hands at once and never mention it again.

By 1974 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the logbook, and a new boatman from the next harbour ⑧ astonishes even the oldest hands without complaint every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pier, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ astonished everybody in the room again when nobody else would.

⑩ To astonish everybody in the room, my mother said in 1979, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the harbour remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the harbour forgets, somebody astonishes everybody in the room with great care again and somebody must astonish everybody in the room without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 使吃惊（一般过去式 astonished everybody in the room：1967 年渔人头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 使吃惊（一般现在 astonishes everybody in the room：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 使吃惊（不定式 to astonish everybody in the room：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 使吃惊（过去完成时 had astonished everybody in the room：1961 年七月的航海日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 使吃惊（动名词 astonishing everybody in the room 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使愣住（astonish even the oldest hands：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使愣住连最老练的几位）
G. v. 使愣住（astonish even the oldest hands：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 使吃惊（后段两处：新来的船工照例 astonishes even the oldest hands，而母亲又一次 astonished everybody in the room）

items.q: to astonish everybody in the room
astonished everybody in the room before

to astonish everybody in the room

answers.why: astonish 意为“使吃惊”，1967 年渔人毫无怨言地使吃惊屋里的每一个人，那是渔港里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 astonished。
astonish 意为“使吃惊”，自那以后渔人小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 astonishes。
astonish 意为“使吃惊”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯使吃惊屋里的每一个人”，此处为不定式 to astonish everybody in the room。
astonish 意为“使吃惊”，航海日志里 七月 那行字说明早在 1974 年之前就有人使吃惊过，故用过去完成时 had astonished。
astonish 意为“使吃惊”，渔人说“使吃惊屋里的每一个人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 astonishing everybody in the room 作主语。
astonish 意为“使愣住”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使愣住连最老练的几位”，should ever 之后用原形 astonish even the oldest hands。
astonish 意为“使愣住”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使愣住连最老练的几位（astonish even the oldest hands at once），以后再也不要提起。
astonish 意为“使吃惊”，新来的船工每个汛期都照例使愣住连最老练的几位，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 astonishes。
astonish 意为“使吃惊”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地使吃惊屋里的每一个人，用一般过去式 astonished 叙述。
astonish 意为“使吃惊”，结尾那句是母亲 1979 年的话：要使吃惊屋里的每一个人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和渔港记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1967 年，渔人毫无怨言地使吃惊屋里的每一个人；渔港里每一个船工都说这是头一回。（astonished everybody in the room）
多年以后，渔人仍小心翼翼地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（astonishes everybody in the room）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯使吃惊屋里的每一个人这件事本身。（to astonish everybody in the room）
早在 1961 年就有人使吃惊屋里的每一个人，七月那天航海日志上的一行字就是证据。（had astonished everybody in the room）
渔人说过，毫无怨言地使吃惊屋里的每一个人这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（astonishing everybody in the room 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻使愣住连最老练的几位，以后再也不要提起。（astonish even the oldest hands，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 astonish 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1967 the fisherman astonished everybody in the room without complaint, and nobody in the harbour forgot it.
Even now the fisherman astonishes everybody in the room with great care whenever the harbour asks.
Astonishing everybody in the room without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever astonish even the oldest hands with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new boatman from the next harbour astonishes even the oldest hands without complaint every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother astonished everybody in the room again, and the harbour remembered that half.
